title: Untamed Earthy Tunisian Almond Tagine
description: A traditional Tunisian dish featuring almond paste, with a rich earthy flavor and a nostalgic cheese-pull texture, served on a hot stone plate. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe combines the warmth of spices with the crunch of almonds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond paste, olive oil, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Transfer the mixture to a hot stone plate or a clay tagine.
Top the mixture with chopped dried apricots.
Bake the tagine in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, the tagine is served with a crusty bread or over couscous.
To enhance the cheese-pull texture, sprinkle some grated cheese on top of the tagine before serving.
